segments.text: A priest who teaches at St. Marianne Academy on a relief basis. His church is located a short distance from the academy grounds. In public he is well-respected by both students and staff members for his serious manner and acute sense of responsibility.

He is also famous as an exorcist without peer. He is usually referred cases of women possessed by evil spirits of a lustful nature which the regular exorcists cannot handle. Despite his success and fame, he refuses all candidates who wish to acknowledge him as Master and learn under his tutelage.

The source of his exorcism ability is the contract made between one of his ancestors and the Demon Nia. In exchange for Nia's oath not to attack humans for their souls, the Fujiwara family would provide her with a steady source of nourishment in the form of exorcised evil spirits. Although less effective than human souls, the sheer quantity makes up for difference in quality. The contract is passed down through the Fujiwara bloodline and since it requires the exorcist to exercise his powers through sexual copulation Kiyoharu is extremely reluctant and evasive when he's pressed upon this issue by Lily and other aspiring disciples.

Having lived alone for much of his professional life, he's capable of maintaining his own household and keeping his dual life a secret. Because his usual "clients" tend to have lost their reason when possessed, he is conflicted when he's forced to use his exorcism powers against three students he is close to and who retain awareness of the experience throughout.
町外れにある教会に一人で住む神父。
少々堅苦しい喋り方をするが中身までカタブツというわけではなく、喋り方はただの癖。
聖職者専門の養成学園「聖マリアンヌ女学院」に現役の神父として非常勤の講師をしている。
人に取り憑き悪さをする悪霊と戦う「真の祓魔師」。
彼が使う「聖技」と呼ばれる特殊な技は天下無双の強さ
ただしその技には公にできない“ある理由“があり、それ故に無敵の強さを誇りながらごく一部の関係者にしか知られていない。

A student at St. Marianne's Academy who frequents Kiyoharu's church every morning for prayers. She is famous at the academy for the accuracy of her fortune telling and is never short of clients both inside and outside the Academy walls. Despite her natural born talents, she is always cheerful and is equally friendly to all which further adds to her popularity amongst her fellow students.

Her fortune telling method relies on a standard pack of playing cards. If she wants a question answered, she will shuffle the deck and then draw a card at random. Depending on what she "sees", she usually has an answer to her question. If it's someone else who wants a question answered, she will shuffle the deck and ask the client to draw a card which she will then interpret. Her ability is surprisingly versatile and she can even use it to tell if someone is lying to her.

A scion of a clan famous for its spiritual powers, she was considered one of the strongest mediums ever born into the family. Unfortunately her powers made her easily susceptible to possession from malicious spiritual entities so she has considerable experience with exorcists which her family employed to help her. A big reason why she enrolled in the Academy was in hopes of developing a measure of control over her considerable gifts, however at the start of the story she has had little success to date.

Nia surmises Hinata's fortune telling powers are her unconscious ability to call upon spirits of nature which briefly possess her allowing foresight into the future. The school board is aware of her talents and keeps other students with similar talents like hers on their student roll. Occasionally she's called upon by corporation CEOs on important business decisions.
Depending on player decisions, Hinata either succeeds in ridding herself of the spirits which possess her and the others or her soul ends up fusing with the spirits.
「大丈夫です！ 神様のご加護があればなんとかなりますよ♪」
聖マリアンヌ女学院に通う聖職者の見習い少女。
純粋が服を着て歩いているようなピュアな少女で人を疑うことを知らない。
表裏のないその性格ゆえに彼女を慕う人は多く、学園内でも屈指の人気を誇る。
ひなたが有名なのは、彼女が行う「とても的中率の高い占い」のせいでもある。
ときには特別に学園の外から彼女に占ってもらうためだけに来客がやってきたりするなど彼女もまたその筋での有名人だったりする。
そんな占いの的中率の高さには、彼女が持つある才能が関係していて……？

Hinata's best friend and classmate. She is half-Japanese with both of her parents hailing from outside Japan. Her mixed parentage explains her striking appearance and physique marking her out from her classmates. Her emotions show easily and she's frequently teased by Nia for comic effect.

Because both of her parents are active True Exorcists, Lily was inspired by their example and way of life and enrolled at the Academy in hopes of becoming a respected and capable Exorcist just like them. As such, she is aware of Kiyoharu's other occupation and persistently asks to be his disciple each time they meet (she doesn't hide this from her best friend Hinata either).
Hinata's tendency to let slip things which shouldn't normally be said in public forces Lily to keep an eye on her in order to keep a lid on her excesses.

Her parents spend most of their time outside of Japan because of work so she's had to be independent since young and is extremely skilled at the traditional feminine skills of cooking and sewing. Although the family income isn't low, her parents are extremely charitable and leave little behind for the household. Lily's manner of speech is an affected one and put on from watching shows.

Depending on player choices, Lily either succeeds in exorcising the evil spirits using Kiyoharu's techniques or fuses her soul with the evil spirits. In the former she discovers her gift of reinforcing the spiritual power of other exorcists through physical contact allowing Kiyoharu to perform regular exorcisms without using his bloodline's techniques.
「先生！ 今日こそは絶対に弟子入りを認めていただきますわよ！」
ひなたの親友にして、外国の血が入ったダブルの少女。
それ故に起伏に富んだ体つきをしているが本人はあまり気にしていない。
やや特徴的な口調をしているが、それは幼い頃に見ていたアニメなどの影響というだけで別に高貴な家の出身というわけではない。……いや、むしろ貧乏だったりする。
しかしそんなことを感じさせない元気にあふれる女の子。
彼女の両親も真の祓魔師であり、故にどこからか清春も真の祓魔師であることを知っている。
いまいち祓魔師としての才能が目覚めていない彼女は清春に弟子入りを懇願しているが清春自身にとある問題があるため断り続けている。
しかし彼女が諦める様子はなく、顔を合わすたびに弟子入りを申し込まれている状態だったりする。

A final year student at St. Marianne's Academy who volunteers at Kiyoharu's church on a part-time basis. She is the Representative of the entire student body and is respected and admired for her ability to listen to and resolve the concerns of all students without prejudice.

Although Kiyoharu values her assistance, she has a tendency to go overboard when someone is in need and has to be gently restrained before she goes out of control. Kiyoharu knows this and has learnt to gently bring her back to reality.
Her request to see the totem of Kiyoharu's church as a reward for keeping watch on his behalf after one of his late night exorcisms is partly responsible for the events early on in the game.

Saki's drive to help others whatever the cost to herself stems from her childhood experience. A normal child with no special spiritual powers born into a family in charge of another church, she witnessed the good deeds of her parents but was frequently left in the care of her grandparents for long periods and was lonely as a result. Her drive to help others and the skills she acquired to serve others better are later diagnosed as her innate desire not to be hated by anyone; this causes problems later on during her route in the final stages of the exorcism cycle.
Unlike her two juniors, she is the only one who doesn't have an alternate ending.
「遠慮なさらなくてもいいのですよ。 これは私が好きでしていることなのですから」
聖マリアンヌの最上級生で、常に穏やかで落ち着いた態度をした大人な少女。
その穏やかさはいかなるときも崩れず、見習いであることを忘れさせられてしまうような雰囲気を既に持っている。
その溢れんばかりの愛情がゆえ、どんな相手にも少々過保護がすぎるところもあるがそれもまた彼女のキャラクターであり愛される側面でもある。
学園生全員から選ばれる『総代』という学生の代表のような立場にあり、学園内では有名人。
すでに将来を約束されたような立場にいるが本人は決して奢らず粛々と日々を過ごしている。
そういった立場もあり、学園によく出入りしている清春とは交流が長くよく知った仲。
咲もまた清春のことを現役の神父として尊敬している。

The female demon who appears after the totem crystal in Kiyoharu's church breaks. She helps avert the immediate crisis affecting the three students and then explains her position as the Fujiwara clan's guardian spirit and the fount of their exorcism powers.

Having slept for decades within the crystal, she is the epitome of unbridled curiosity and doesn't hold back with her speech or her desires. She loves teasing Hinata and Lily in particular, but is easily flustered by praise.

Prior to her contract with the Fujiwara clan she was a demon who hunted humans for their souls to increase her powers. Eventually she met her match in Kiyoharu's ancestor but at the end of a decisive battle neither side had the strength to claim victory which led to the contract proposal. Each time the Fujiwara clan exorcises evil spirits through sex, these spirits are transferred to the crystal where they are eventually deconstructed into pure energy which Nia feeds on. On her part Nia can use the energy she receives to teach the Fujiwara exorcist new techniques or creates new "equipment" (usually sex toys) to better assist the Fujiwara exorcist with his work.

Her magical abilities depend greatly on the amount of energy from evil spirits provided by the Fujiwaras. Her speciality is mind-control magic, but is capable of other feats like flight or body modification. She has knowledge of other fields of magic (like Hinata's seances) but isn't necessarily capable of executing them.

It's later revealed in her route that Fujiwara Kiyoharu is the first member of his clan to treat her as a friend or lover. All of his forebears would have sex with her or receive her gifts but they saw her as a demon to be feared and kept their distance.

Her true name is "Eternia Chaosblood". If Kiyoharu uses her true name he can command her to do whatever he likes. Despite this he has little intention of doing so and only appears to call her by that name when they're having sex.
「クスッ♪ いいじゃない。 気持ちいいこと、あなたも好きでしょう？」
清春の教会に安置されていた「神体」が壊れたのと同時に姿を現した悪魔の少女。
清春だけでなく、彼の一族すべてに関わりがある縁の深い存在。
享楽的とまではいかないが、悪魔らしいラフな性格で細かいことは気にしない。
本人曰く、もともとはもっと悪魔らしかったが、長い年月を経て人間っぽくなったらしい。
見た目は愛らしい小柄な少女だが、生きてきた年月は明らかに人のそれを超えており、ときどき清春以上に大人びた、達観したような態度を見せることもある。
なんだかんだ言って面倒見はいい、見た目は少女でも中身は大人な悪魔っ子。
